records.name: Real-Time Macroeconomic Measurement
records.purpose: Reconstruct what could actually have been known at historical dates, preserve official vintages and revisions, measure release latency, and evaluate nowcasts without revised-data leakage.

records.name: Alternative Economic Measurement
records.purpose: Measure economic activity with physical and high-frequency signals while treating divergence from official statistics as a research question rather than automatic evidence of official error.

records.name: Firm Dynamics
records.purpose: Build source-bounded observable firm panels and probabilistic activity states to study entry, exit, hiring, procurement, technology adoption and survival without claiming census coverage.

records.name: State and Markets
records.purpose: Map and identify the effects of state capital, SOEs, sovereign wealth funds, procurement and industrial-policy interventions on firms, sectors and market structure.

records.name: Statistical Integrity
records.purpose: Test comparability, preserve methodological changes, expose source lineage, quantify uncertainty and stress-test public economic claims before they are repeated as settled facts.

cross_program_infrastructure.name: MENA Evidence Terminal
cross_program_infrastructure.role: Machine-readable provenance backbone across all research programmes.

research_standard.rule: Every material empirical conclusion must survive at least one deliberately hostile but defensible specification.
